name: XTR XC SPD pedal pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 318 g for the left/right PD-M9100 SPD pedal pair, from the explicit /pair weight row in the 2025–2026 specification handbook. Selected normal-axle reference; the separately listed 316 g short-axle pair is not used. The handbook notes a supplied 1.0 mm cleat spacer; the weight row does not enumerate cleats or loose accessories.
